messages:
Elena (CEO): thanks everyone for joining the sec/privacy Q&A portion of the all-hands. open floor for quick clarifying q's and follow-ups. :wave:
Mina (Support): quick one from a customer: do we have a public SOC2 summary they can reference before the full report is out?
Arman (CISO): yes. we will publish a SOC 2 readiness whitepaper + control matrix next week. full Type II report will be available to customers under NDA once audit completes.
Priya (Head of Product): follow-up: will the whitepaper include impact on hosted feature toggles (i.e., data residency, telemetry)?
Arman (CISO): the matrix will call out controls that affect telemetry and telemetry opt-outs. data residency options are part of Dedicated/Private offerings and documented separately.
Jo (Eng Infra): regarding VPC/private GA: pilot customers get isolated control plane option and separate audit logs. GA timeline still Q4 but expect limited pilots in late Q3.
Mina (Support): a customer asked if they can request 7-year audit logs for regulatory reasons — is that supported?
Kofi (Legal): long-term archival is available as an enterprise add-on. we use encrypted S3 with lifecycle policies. customers must sign data retention and access terms; DSR processes apply.
Elena (CEO): BYOK question we didn't fully answer: can hosted customers 'bring keys' now or later?
Arman (CISO): short: BYOK is available for Dedicated and Private today. For hosted multi-tenant BYOK we will offer a customer-managed key (CMK) option where keys are wrapped; ETA is end of year. HSM-backed key stores are a next-phase enterprise feature.
Priya (Head of Product): will BYOK change how we do deployment snapshots/backups?
Jo (Eng Infra): yes: when customers opt for BYOK, backups are envelope-encrypted with the customer's DEK. restore requires access to that key unless customer permits key escrow. we'll include this in the runbook.
Mina (Support): any expected support burden from BYOK customers?
Arman (CISO): some onboarding support is expected (key rotation policies, emergency access procedures). we'll provide a checklist and automation to minimize manual steps.
Mina (Support): noted, will coordinate docs with product.
A user (via thread): what about privacy/regression testing — will we have automated evals for PII leakage?
Priya (Head of Product): yes, Privacy Controls + Optimize will include prompt/eval suites to catch regressions. early versions will be opt-in and customer-provided datasets can be used for private evals.
Kofi (Legal): one more legal note: if customers want proof of key non-access, we need contractual language and audit evidence. reach out to legal for standard addendum.
Jo (Eng Infra): quick tech snippet on logs: 
```
# example audit export
GET /api/v1/audit?start=2025-01-01&end=2025-06-30&format=ndjson
```
Exports are newline-delimited JSON, timestampped, and include route, actor, resource id, and request hash. Sensitive payloads are redacted by default.
Elena (CEO): great. final quick ask: anyone with enterprise customers needing early access to BYOK or longer retention, DM Arman + Kofi and include compliance artifact list. we'll prioritize pilots. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Updated: security-roadmap-notes (internal) https://internal.redwood/docs/security-roadmap
Arman (CISO): i'll post a short follow-up in #eng-security with links to the readiness whitepaper, pilot sign-up form, and PRDs. thanks all for the questions.
